Your closest collaborators are the Account Manager and Development Engineers, with Support looped in as needed. It's a largely independent seat, but you're one of several engineers across the company running the same model for other large accounts. Your new job: Be present in the customer relationship - regular calls, occasional on-site visits, and persistent continuity that the customer's technical teams know you by name and trust your word. Build reference labs and generate reference configurations from them. Participate in OX-internal development of those frameworks. Analyze and resolve technical issues across the OX App Suite 8 stack. Translate customer feature requests and operational requirements into clear input for internal product and development teams, and feedback internal constraints to the customer in terms they can act on. Support the customer through upgrades, configuration changes, and new feature rollouts. Document solutions, workarounds, and deployment specifics - both for the customer and internally - and leave things better documented than you found them. Formal on-call is not part of this role. A typical day mixes customer and internal calls, hands-on lab and reference-configuration work, and technical documentation - with occasional escalation support when a customer integration needs deeper troubleshooting. Limited travel is required for customer-facing meetings (~1-2 per quarter) and company-internal meetings (~1 per quarter).
